newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan Cement 96 exports rise by 35 pct.
newsitem.headline: Jordan Cement 96 exports rise by 35 pct.

text.p: Jordan Cement Factories said on Saturday its exports soared last year by over a third to 951,215 tonnes from 707,750 tonnes in 1995.
The mainly state-owned company, Jordan's sole cement producer, valued last year's exports at $37.5 million. It gave no figure for 1995 export revenue.
Overall production rose last year by three percent to 3.512 million tonnes from 1995, it said in a statement. Domestic sales fell to 2.582 million tonnes in 1996 from 2.680 million.

The company attributed the rise in exports to a successful campaign aimed at targeting new markets and offsetting a decrease in local construction projects, partly affected by uncertainty over Middle East peace developments.
Jordan Cement Factories aims to increase annual production capacity by 300,000 tonnes to 3.9 million tonnes a year by the end of 1997, a JCF marketing official added.
